classifications.note: Handicap contest at the August meeting, kept distinct from the Trophy result.

notes: Pole went to Brian Shawe-Taylor's ERA; Whitehead set fastest lap at 5:06.6. Bob Gerard's ERA was second, sixteen seconds behind, with Cuth Harrison third and Joe Kelly's Alta fourth.

classifications.note: Tommy Wisdom's Jaguar XK120; won both on the road and on handicap in difficult weather.

notes: Moss led from the second lap, averaging 75.15 mph over 224 miles in heavy rain — the first of his seven Tourist Trophy wins.

classifications.note: Set a lap record of 4 minutes 44 seconds.

notes: Farina took pole at 4:51.8 and set the 4:44.0 lap record that stood for four years. Reg Parnell's Ferrari was second, Brian Shawe-Taylor's ERA third; Whitehead's Ferrari blew a piston warming up.

classifications.note: C-Types finished first and second, with another in fourth.

notes: Moss averaged 83.55 mph, ahead of team-mate Peter Walker.

classifications.note: Mike Hawthorn second in a Cooper-Bristol. Moss and Fangio appeared in the experimental V16 BRM; neither finished.

notes: Taruffi took pole at 5:06 and fastest lap at 4:53; Mike Hawthorn's Cooper-Bristol was second and Joe Kelly's Alta third.

notHeldReason: Cancelled after a weak entry and limited public support.

notes: Run as two ten-lap heats and a fourteen-lap final: Hawthorn took pole and fastest lap at 5:00 and won from Ken Wharton's Cooper-Bristol, with Bobby Baird's Ferrari third.

classifications.note: A long, difficult race in fog.

notes: Jaguar's challenge faded with transmission trouble.

notHeldReason: No Ulster Trophy was held at Dundrod in 1954.

classifications.note: The Tourist Trophy was awarded under the handicap classification.

notes: One race, two result systems — name both classifications when discussing the winner. Hawthorn set a sports-car lap record of 4:49 (92.378 mph) — and still finished thirteen seconds short on handicap.

classifications.note: The Ulster Trophy went to the fastest finisher in the mixed sports-car and single-seater handicap.
Bill Smith won the handicap Champion Trophy.

championship: World Sportscar Championship round; Golden Jubilee running of the RAC event

classifications.note: 84 laps in 7 hours 3 minutes 11 seconds at an average 88.32 mph. Hawthorn's Jaguar D-Type set the 4 minute 42 second lap record, about 94.67 mph.

notes: The final car race at Dundrod. Hawthorn's D-Type set the lap record at 4:42 — 94.67 mph — chasing the Mercedes.
